description.en: A plain 2px solid light-gray (#e5e7eb) border with 10px rounded corners.
description.zh: 2px 浅灰（#e5e7eb）实线边框，10px 圆角，最基础的常规描边。

description.en: A 2px dashed indigo (#6366f1) border with 10px rounded corners.
description.zh: 2px 靛蓝（#6366f1）虚线边框，10px 圆角，清新跳跃的虚线描边。

description.en: A 3px dotted amber (#f59e0b) border with 10px rounded corners.
description.zh: 3px 琥珀色（#f59e0b）点线边框，10px 圆角，活泼的点状描边。

description.en: A 4px double violet (#8b5cf6) border with 10px rounded corners — two parallel lines.
description.zh: 4px 紫色（#8b5cf6）双线边框，10px 圆角，两条平行线构成的描边。

description.en: A 3px ridge emerald (#10b981) border with 10px rounded corners — an embossed 3D edge.
description.zh: 3px 祖母绿（#10b981）脊状边框，10px 圆角，凸起的 3D 立体棱边。

description.en: Per-side colors: 4px red top, 2px amber right, 4px emerald bottom, 2px blue left, 10px radius.
description.zh: 四边不同颜色：上 4px 红、右 2px 琥珀、下 4px 翠绿、左 2px 蓝，10px 圆角的多彩边框。

description.en: A 2px border filled with a 45deg rose-to-blue (#f43f5e → #3b82f6) gradient via border-image.
description.zh: border-image 实现的 2px 渐变边框：45 度从玫红（#f43f5e）过渡到蓝（#3b82f6）。

description.en: A 2px gradient ring border from rose to blue at 45deg, carved with a mask-composite trick.
description.zh: 遮罩镂空生成的 2px 渐变描边圆环：45 度玫红到蓝的渐变边框。

description.en: A 2px gradient ring border from emerald to amber at 45deg via mask-composite.
description.zh: 遮罩镂空生成的 2px 渐变描边圆环：45 度翠绿到琥珀的渐变边框。

description.en: A 2px ring border cycling rose, blue, emerald and amber at 45deg — a four-color gradient frame.
description.zh: 2px 渐变描边圆环：45 度依次玫红、蓝、翠绿、琥珀的四色渐变边框。

description.en: A 2px ring border with a vertical 180deg blue-to-amber (#3b82f6 → #f59e0b) gradient.
description.zh: 2px 渐变描边圆环：180 度垂直方向从蓝（#3b82f6）过渡到琥珀（#f59e0b）。

description.en: A 2px ring border in a diagonal 312deg peach (#FFC4BC) fading to transparent.
description.zh: 2px 渐变描边圆环：312 度方向蜜桃色（#FFC4BC）渐隐至透明的温和描边。

description.en: A 2px ring border with a 110deg mint-to-lime (#36d0ac → #84ec5f) gradient.
description.zh: 2px 渐变描边圆环：110 度薄荷绿（#36d0ac）到青柠（#84ec5f）的清新渐变。

description.en: A 2px ring border glowing amber in the middle with transparent ends (90deg) — a horizon light bar.
description.zh: 2px 描边圆环：90 度水平方向中央琥珀色（#f59e0b）发光、两端透明的光带。

description.en: A 2px ring border with a 45deg diagonal green (#84ec5f) glow fading at both ends.
description.zh: 2px 描边圆环：45 度对角方向中央翠绿（#84ec5f）发光、两端透明的斜向光带。

description.en: A 2px ring border with a 135deg diagonal rose (#f43f5e) glow fading at both ends.
description.zh: 2px 描边圆环：135 度对角方向中央玫红（#f43f5e）发光、两端透明的斜向光带。

description.en: A 2px ring border with a vertical 180deg rose (#f43f5e) glow fading at both ends.
description.zh: 2px 描边圆环：180 度垂直方向中央玫红（#f43f5e）发光、上下透明的竖光带。

description.en: Corner accents: green L-shaped marks at the top-left and bottom-right corners (12px × 2px bars).
description.zh: 四角点缀式边框：左上与右下角各一条 12px × 2px 的翠绿 L 形描边。

::after.background: linear-gradient(#00d62b,#00d62b) left top / 12px 2px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#00d62b,#00d62b) left top / 2px 12px no-repeat,  linear-gradient(#00d62b,#00d62b) right bottom / 12px 2px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#00d62b,#00d62b) right bottom / 2px 12px no-repeat

description.en: Corner accents: green L-shaped marks at the top-right and bottom-left corners (12px × 2px bars).
description.zh: 四角点缀式边框：右上与左下角各一条 12px × 2px 的翠绿 L 形描边。

::after.background: linear-gradient(#00d62b,#00d62b) right top / 12px 2px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#00d62b,#00d62b) right top / 2px 12px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#00d62b,#00d62b) left bottom / 12px 2px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#00d62b,#00d62b) left bottom / 2px 12px no-repeat

description.en: Corner accents: green L-shaped marks on all four corners (12px × 2px bars) — a focus frame.
description.zh: 四角点缀式边框：四个角各一条 12px × 2px 的翠绿 L 形描边，取景框效果。

::after.background: linear-gradient(#00d62b,#00d62b) left top / 12px 2px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#00d62b,#00d62b) left top / 2px 12px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#00d62b,#00d62b) right top / 12px 2px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#00d62b,#00d62b) right top / 2px 12px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#00d62b,#00d62b) left bottom / 12px 2px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#00d62b,#00d62b) left bottom / 2px 12px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#00d62b,#00d62b) right bottom / 12px 2px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#00d62b,#00d62b) right bottom / 2px 12px no-repeat

name.zh: 内嵌绿色角标（左上-右下）

description.en: Inset corner accents: green L-shaped marks offset 6px inward at the top-left and bottom-right.
description.zh: 内嵌角标式边框：左上与右下角向内偏移 6px 的翠绿 L 形描边（14px × 2px）。

::after.background: linear-gradient(#00d62b,#00d62b) left 6px top / 14px 2px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#00d62b,#00d62b) left top 6px / 2px 14px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#00d62b,#00d62b) right 6px bottom / 14px 2px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#00d62b,#00d62b) right bottom 6px / 2px 14px no-repeat

name.zh: 内嵌绿色角标（右上-左下）

description.en: Inset corner accents: green L-shaped marks offset 6px inward at the top-right and bottom-left.
description.zh: 内嵌角标式边框：右上与左下角向内偏移 6px 的翠绿 L 形描边（14px × 2px）。

::after.background: linear-gradient(#00d62b,#00d62b) right 6px top / 14px 2px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#00d62b,#00d62b) right top 6px / 2px 14px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#00d62b,#00d62b) left 6px bottom / 14px 2px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#00d62b,#00d62b) left bottom 6px / 2px 14px no-repeat

description.en: Inset corner accents: green L-shaped marks offset 6px inward on all four corners.
description.zh: 内嵌角标式边框：四个角向内偏移 6px 的翠绿 L 形描边（14px × 2px），聚焦框效果。

::after.background: linear-gradient(#00d62b,#00d62b) left 6px top / 14px 2px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#00d62b,#00d62b) left top 6px / 2px 14px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#00d62b,#00d62b) right 6px top / 14px 2px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#00d62b,#00d62b) right top 6px / 2px 14px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#00d62b,#00d62b) left 6px bottom / 14px 2px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#00d62b,#00d62b) left bottom 6px / 2px 14px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#00d62b,#00d62b) right 6px bottom / 14px 2px no-repeat, linear-gradient(#00d62b,#00d62b) right bottom 6px / 2px 14px no-repeat

description.en: A 4px gradient ring from red to orange (#ED303C → #FF9C5B, 60deg) with a five-petal flower mask.
description.zh: 5px 宽的红橙渐变圆环（60 度 #ED303C → #FF9C5B），配合五瓣花形遮罩镂空，花朵描边。
